summary: AGRIOS Phase D scale+moat sprint: full backend + frontend regression. Backend pytest 20/20 PASS (covering liquidity signals 200+404, supplier-performance score/band/badges, farmer earnings w/ 403-for-buyer, price-alerts CRUD w/ farmer 403 and auto-trigger on listing-create verified end-to-end — triggered_count incremented and a kind='price_alert' notification landed in buyer's /api/notifications — market price-trend + demand-heatmap, growth invite for buyer+farmer, admin KPIs w/ buyer 403, and Phase A/B/C regression /api/health|/api/config|/api/listings|/api/admin/reconcile). Frontend: BuyerHome shows price-alerts-promo + market-intel-promo; /app/buyer/alerts renders PriceAlerts page with working create (row visible after submit) + delete, all expected testids (create-alert-form, alert-crop-input, alert-price-input, alert-qty-input, alert-submit-btn, alerts-list, alert-row-*, alert-delete-*); ProductDetail has data-testid='liquidity-signals' loaded live; FarmerDashboard renders supplier-score-card (score 38, band D, Verified pro badge, 3 orders done, 1 repeat buyer); AdminDashboard admin-kpis-row contains 4 KPI tiles (admin-kpi-gmv-7d, admin-kpi-escrow, admin-kpi-repeat, admin-kpi-loans) with expected labels; AppShell sidebar shows 'Price alerts', 'Market intel', 'Earnings', 'Market intel' (farmer) nav items. Old-seed empty states on earnings/price-trend/heatmap are expected per spec.

issues: Review request specified data-testid='price-trend-card' but page only exposes 'demand-heatmap' and 'hot-crops-strip' — the price-trend card in the DOM has NO data-testid. Add data-testid='price-trend-card' for test stability.
Review request specified 'demand-heatmap-card' but rendered testid is 'demand-heatmap'. Align naming (either update spec or rename component) to match the pattern used by other cards.

Review request specified crop switch buttons should carry 'crop-btn-*' testids — no crop-btn-* testids found in DOM. Crop switcher may still work visually but cannot be targeted in regression tests. Add data-testid='crop-btn-<slug>' on each crop toggle.

KPI tiles 'TOTAL EARNINGS', 'ORDERS RELEASED', 'REPEAT BUYERS' render correctly but lack individual data-testids (e.g. earnings-kpi-total, earnings-kpi-orders, earnings-kpi-repeat). best-crops-card/best-regions-card/repeat-buyers-card/earnings-period-switch are wired, but the 3 top KPI tiles and the weekly-earnings chart container are missing testids.

action_items: MarketIntel.jsx: add data-testid='price-trend-card' to the price-trend block, rename 'demand-heatmap' → 'demand-heatmap-card' (or update spec), and add data-testid='crop-btn-<crop>' to each crop toggle button so test selectors match review request.
FarmerEarnings.jsx: add data-testid on the 3 KPI tiles (earnings-kpi-total/-orders/-repeat) and on the weekly-earnings chart container for regression stability.
Nothing else required — all other Phase D items ship green.
critical_code_review_comments: phase_d.py::listing_liquidity — recent_viewers = min(max(views_total//8, 1), 12) is a deterministic mock, not a real live-viewer metric. Harmless for launch but label it internally as an estimate; consider wiring a real ephemeral view-events collection with TTL index for Phase E.

phase_d.py::supplier_performance — composite score formula is hard-coded and not versioned. When the algorithm changes, old scores silently shift. Recommend adding 'score_version': 1 to the response and persisting historical scores for trend analysis.

phase_d.py::check_alerts_for_listing — regex match on crop uses '^{crop}$' with $options:'i' but does NOT escape regex metacharacters in crop. Any crop name containing '.', '*', '(' etc. could either over-match or error. Add re.escape() before the regex.

phase_d.py::admin_kpis — aggregates over orders without a status filter on orders_7d/orders_30d counts (includes cancelled/pending). Semantically 'orders this week' likely means funded+released. Clarify by renaming or adding status filter.

phase_d.py::price_trend — datetime.fromisoformat(d) will raise ValueError on malformed dates since d keys come from DB dates that went through isoformat, should be safe, but wrap in try/except defensively since series is user-facing.

Frontend MarketIntel page: page loads client-side only; there is no loading skeleton shown for the 2-3 seconds while /api/market/price-trend and /api/market/demand-heatmap resolve — users may see a blank card. Add Skeleton/Spinner.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ price alerts via API + 1 TEST_UI_Cassava alert via UI (some were auto-cleaned by test teardown, two remain for retest observation). Created 1 fresh Tomato listing by farmer (location='Lagos TEST_<uuid>') to exercise price-alert auto-trigger path; this fired a price_alert notification for the buyer and incremented alerts.triggered_count, confirming the end-to-end hook from server.py::create_listing -> _check_alerts_for_listing -> notify() works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D ships green end-to-end. Minor testid naming gaps on MarketIntel (price-trend-card missing, demand-heatmap vs demand-heatmap-card, no crop-btn-* testids) and 3 KPI tiles on FarmerEarnings — these are additive test-selector fixes, not functional bugs. All 20 backend pytest cases at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_d.py pass; include this file in the regression run going forward. Login form in this app has button text 'Log in' (NOT type=submit) — use get_by_role('button', name='Log in') for Playwright scripts. Product detail route is /app/marketplace/:id (NOT /app/buyer/listing/:id). Login route is /login (NOT /app/login). Old seed orders are >90d so earnings/price-trend/heatmap correctly render empty states — not a bug per review-request note.
rca of the issue: One pytest initially failed (test_alert_auto_triggers_on_matching_listing) with 422 on POST /api/listings because server's OrderCreate/ListingCreate Pydantic model requires 'quantity_kg' (not 'qty_available_kg'). Test payload updated to include both quantity_kg AND qty_available_kg (server accepts both). No server-side change required. The Phase D price-alert auto-trigger chain is verified: buyer posts alert for 'Tomato' max 9999 → farmer posts Tomato listing at 500 NGN/kg → _check_alerts_for_listing runs regex match on crop (case-insensitive anchored), country.upper() equality, max_price_per_kg >= listing price, qty >= min_quantity_kg → notification inserted with kind='price_alert' ref=listing_id + alerts.triggered_count $inc'd. All verified by post-create assertions.
